Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 9.5.0 (report dated April 7, 2023) found code signatures for 6 known tracker SDK(s): Appdynamics (analytics profiling), Braze (formerly Appboy) (analytics advertisement location), Google CrashLytics (crash reporting), Google Firebase Analytics (analytics), OpenTelemetry (OpenCensus, OpenTracing) (analytics), Segment (analytics profiling). A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
